title: AI model vs agent harness vs orchestration layer
description: Most people throwing around the word "agent" have no idea what's actually happening under the hood. A model just predicts the next token. A harness wraps that in a loop and hands it tools to act on the world. An orchestration layer runs dozens of those harnesses in parallel without blowing past the context window. Understanding all three is going to be one of the most valuable skills as agents start replacing real knowledge work. I break down exactly how it fits together inside my community. Link in bio.
